content: Behavior on failed certificate verification After the Dcm has verified a certificate and KeyM_ReturnType is set to KEYM_E_SIGNATURE_FAIL, the Dcm shall send a negative response with NRC set to 'Certificate verification failed - Invalid Signature'.
